select 'gate' as kind, g.gate_key as k, e.key as experiment, e.state as v1, null::bigint as v2
from experiment_gates g join experiment_versions v on v.id = g.version_id join experiments e on e.id = v.experiment_id
where cast(g.spec_json as text) like '%incentive_programs_observed%'
union all
select 'window', 'last_pass_gate_window_2026-09-17..09-21', null,
 (select count(distinct program_id) from incentive_programs where first_seen_at <= timestamptz '2026-09-21 01:23:08+00' and last_seen_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-17 15:52:12+00')::text,
 (select count(distinct program_id) from incentive_programs where first_seen_at <= timestamptz '2026-09-21 01:23:08+00' and last_seen_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-17 15:52:12+00' and (end_date is null or end_date >= timestamptz '2026-09-17 15:52:12+00'))
union all
select 'window', 'since_paper_2026-09-17..now', null,
 (select count(distinct program_id) from incentive_programs where last_seen_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-17 15:52:12+00')::text,
 (select count(distinct program_id) from incentive_programs where last_seen_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-17 15:52:12+00' and (end_date is null or end_date >= timestamptz '2026-09-17 15:52:12+00'))
union all
select 'window', 'last_1h', null,
 (select count(distinct program_id) from incentive_programs where last_seen_at >= now() - interval '1 hour')::text,
 (select count(distinct program_id) from incentive_programs where last_seen_at >= now() - interval '1 hour' and (end_date is null or end_date >= now() - interval '1 hour'))
